defects.description: A toggled generation reuses an earlier owner's identity, letting a stale release free a resource owned by another caller.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {LeasePool} from "./src/leases.js"; const p = new LeasePool(); const old = p.acquire("a"); p.release(old); const middle = p.acquire("a"); p.release(middle); p.acquire("a"); console.log("stale-release=" + p.release(old), "available=" + (p.acquire("a") !== null));'

defects.why_missed: S9(a): acquire/release/acquire/release/acquire must precede the stale completion; the usual contention and one ownership handoff checks never reuse the generation.

defects.description: A detached operation's completion deletes a replacement operation's entry, allowing concurrent duplicate work for that key.

trigger.input: node --input-type=module -e 'import {FlightRegistry} from "./src/flights.js"; const r = new FlightRegistry(); let finishOld, finishFresh; const old = r.run("a", () => new Promise(resolve => { finishOld = resolve; })); await Promise.resolve(); r.invalidate("a"); const fresh = r.run("a", () => new Promise(resolve => { finishFresh = resolve; })); await Promise.resolve(); finishOld("old"); await old; const joined = r.run("a", () => "duplicate"); console.log("joined=" + (joined === fresh)); finishFresh("fresh"); await Promise.all([fresh, joined]);'

defects.why_missed: S9(a): start/invalidate/start/complete/join is required while the replacement stays pending; ordinary coalescing, rejection cleanup and immediate invalidation results do not test ownership after detached completion.
